product_overview: ConTex.ai is an AI website builder that turns a natural-language brief into a single-file HTML website, with preview, editing, and project management in a React/Express/MongoDB app. It also supports Google sign-in, credit-based billing, and Razorpay payments for premium usage.
core_goals: Generate a usable first-draft website from a natural-language prompt.
Allow authenticated users to preview, inspect, and refine generated websites.
Persist and manage saved projects in a secure user-specific dashboard.
Provide public access to published websites while keeping drafts private.
Support credit-based plans and payments with correct, idempotent billing behavior.
Ensure reliable authentication, safe error handling, and production-ready deployment settings.

features.name: Authentication and user sessions
features.description: Users sign in with Google, receive a session, access protected routes, and can log out to clear their session.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/google with a valid Google/Firebase identity token -> Receive 200 with a user session and session cookie -> GET protected routes such as /api/website or /api/user/me with the session cookie -> Receive 200 with authenticated user data
POST /api/auth/google with an invalid or missing identity token -> Receive 401 authentication error -> Protected routes remain inaccessible without a valid session
POST /api/auth/logout with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 success and cleared session cookie -> GET protected routes without a session cookie -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Website generation and editor workflow
features.description: Authenticated users can generate a new website from a prompt, retrieve saved projects, update generated code, and preview published sites.
user_flows: POST /api/website/generate with a valid prompt and authenticated session -> Receive 200 with a saved Website project -> GET /api/website/:id with the returned project ID -> Receive 200 with the stored project for editing and previewing
POST /api/website/generate with an empty or invalid prompt -> Receive 400 invalid prompt -> No website project is created or stored
GET /api/website with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with Website[] for the current user -> GET /api/website/:id for one returned project ID -> Receive 200 with that project data
PUT /api/website/:id with valid updated code and ownership via authenticated session -> Receive 200 with updated Website data -> GET /api/website/:id -> Receive 200 with the latest saved code
PUT /api/website/:id with a project ID owned by another user or an invalid session -> Receive 403 unauthorized or 404 project not found -> No code changes are saved

GET /api/website/public/:slug without authentication for a published slug -> Receive 200 with PublishedWebsite content -> GET /api/website/public/:slug for an unpublished or missing slug -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Billing and plan management
features.description: Users can view available plans, create Razorpay orders for a selected plan, and verify payment to receive credits.
user_flows: GET /api/payment/plans without authentication -> Receive 200 with available Plan[] -> POST /api/payment/create-order with a selected planId and authenticated session -> Receive 200 with a server-created order -> POST /api/payment/verify with Razorpay payment details -> Receive 200 with successful payment verification and credit grant
POST /api/payment/create-order without authentication -> Receive an authentication error -> No order is created
POST /api/payment/verify with an invalid Razorpay signature or replayed payment details -> Receive 400 invalid signature -> No credits are granted

GET /api/payment/plans -> Receive 200 with pricing plans -> POST /api/payment/create-order with a client-tampered planId or amount attempt -> Receive order data based on server-side trusted plan configuration, not client pricing
